column2: [From.GetBestName] has gathered a band of warriors and sworn to go raiding in foreign lands until [From.GetSheHe] has carved out a fortune of [From.GetHerHis] own. The skalds and the camp-fire boasters are already making songs about it.
Well... good luck with that!
The [GetRootFromInsult] [From.GetBestName] has declared that [From.GetSheHe] means to seize land from my realm by force, with [From.GetHerHis] host of reavers and cut-throats.
We must stop [From.GetHerHim].

Dear [GetFromReverseRelation],

[From.Religion.GetRandomGodNameCap] has smiled on me in my travels. I have taken so much plunder that I scarcely know what to do with it all. What I lack is a hall of my own, as befits a warrior of my standing. I therefore propose a small exchange.

Signed,
your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName]
My friend, gold is the true mark of nobility!
No. My land is not for sale.
Word has reached court that [From.GetTitledFirstName], who lays claim to my titles, is hiring sell-swords and exiles for an attack against me!
I hope [From.GetSheHe] is not prone to... accidents.
Word has reached me that an ambitious adventurer, [From.GetTitledFirstName], is gathering men for an attack on my lands!
I think of assassins...

Word comes up the coast with the fishing boats: [From.GetTitledFirstName], a son of an Arabyan house with no land of [From.GetHerHis] own, is gathering corsairs, desert riders and hungry younger sons, and has sworn to take a kingdom from my lands. Word comes up the coast with the fishing boats: [From.GetTitledFirstName], a son of an Arabyan house with no land of [From.GetHerHis] own, is gathering corsairs, desert riders and hungry younger sons, and has sworn to finish what Sultan Jaffar began. Estalia has not forgotten Jaffar. The old men still point at the scorched stones of Magritta and tell of the summer the sails came from the south and the knights of the Old World had to cross the mountains to drive them back.
Let [From.GetHerHim] come. Our walls have outlasted sultans.
Pay for watchtowers and coast guards.
Coast Watch
Watchtowers and coast guards stand ready against a landing from Araby.
